scope: Authorize a future telemetry-only implementation that preserves Phase 4 v4 failure diagnostics and measures integrated final-composite trajectory ownership. This document does not implement instrumentation, authorize GPU execution, reopen the frozen ordinal-1 attempt or change any product visual contract.

frozen_diagnostic_decision.blocking_capability: Resolved integrated final-composite per-sample ownership and pre-failure serialization are absent.

implementation_sequence.purpose: Make every machine failure durable and diagnosable before fail-closed termination, without changing classification or rendering.

mandatory_control_flow.compute_audit: Complete contrast and compound audit, candidate enumeration and exclusive arbitration.
mandatory_control_flow.serialize_before_gate: Unconditionally construct, append and flush exactly one capture result row before require(machinePass) or any equivalent throw/return.
mandatory_control_flow.then_fail_closed: After durable serialization, enforce the unchanged machinePass decision and terminate immediately on failure.
mandatory_control_flow.serialization_failure_rule: If the row is incomplete, cannot be appended or cannot be flushed, fail closed with a distinct telemetry-preservation error and do not claim a capture result.

acceptance_tests: A CPU-only synthetic machinePass=false case writes and flushes one complete FAILED row before the expected exception.
Removing any required field makes the test fail closed.
A forced append or flush failure produces a distinct telemetry-preservation error and no success claim.
A machinePass=true case writes the same schema exactly once and then completes.
The frozen ordinal-1 replay and PPM are consumed read-only and produce a preserved failure row with 95 immutable source IDs; analytic values remain explicitly non-final until Step B is present.
forbidden: Converting a failed capture to PASS
Changing candidate eligibility, thresholds, probe inventory or classification
Overwriting the frozen ordinal-1 result root

implementation_sequence.purpose: Measure final trajectory ownership in lockstep with the production color frame so a counted pixel is sample-accurate, finally visible and exclusively attributable.

integration_contract.same_render_graph: The semantic ownership path is attached to the production scene/trajectory/resolve/tone-map/product-UI graph; a detached replay framebuffer is forbidden as final proof.
integration_contract.same_geometry_and_order: Use the exact production vertices, transforms, primitive order, actual-then-predicted z-order and draw submission; do not rebuild an analytic substitute for final proof.
integration_contract.same_clip: Apply the same homogeneous clip, safe-area clip, play-surface stencil, viewport, scissor and fragment discard decisions.
integration_contract.same_msaa: Use the exact production MSAA sample count, sample positions and per-sample coverage. No single-sample proxy may claim resolved ownership.
integration_contract.same_blend_visibility: Carry per-sample semantic coverage through the trajectory blend decision; covered but fully replaced samples are not final evidence.
integration_contract.same_resolve: Resolve semantic ownership using the same sample visibility and final draw order as color; record winning and losing sample coverage rather than forcing alpha to one.
integration_contract.tone_map_pairing: After ACES tone map, pair each resolved semantic owner with the exact final LDR RGB used for contrast checks.
integration_contract.later_ui_ownership: Apply later product UI clip and coverage. A final UI-owned sample has track=none and can never satisfy a trajectory probe.
integration_contract.readback_correspondence: Color and semantic evidence share physical dimensions, origin, frame/capture ID and immutable content digest. Any mismatch fails closed.
integration_contract.production_color_invariance: Instrumentation may add capture-only metadata resources but must not alter production color bytes, timing order, visual assets or product exposure.

probe_attribution_contract.cross_component_substitution: Allow only gate-approved same-track core, exposed solid dash-gap, outer halo edge, nearest tick and same endpoint evidence.
probe_attribution_contract.true_coordinate_frame: Use the unshifted projected path tangent and normal; Euclidean-as-normal and forced zero-longitudinal values are forbidden.
probe_attribution_contract.normal_bound: outer halo radius plus 2 physical pixels, or contracted tick half-length plus 2 for a tick probe
probe_attribution_contract.longitudinal_bound: half local source-probe spacing capped at 12 physical pixels
probe_attribution_contract.exclusive_assignment: Each final sample or resolved ownership contribution is assigned to at most one immutable source_probe_id by same-track distance, primitive ID and probe ordinal.
probe_attribution_contract.minimum_owned_area: At least two 4-connected final physical pixels and at least 1.5 resolved pixel equivalents.

failure_rules: Missing sample payload, unresolved owner, color/semantic frame mismatch or unsupported MSAA mode is MACHINE_FAIL.
Any foreign-track, scene, background, panel, unowned or color-only match counted for a source probe is MACHINE_FAIL.
Any double assignment, probe-ID drift, denominator drift or evidence outside tangent/normal bounds is MACHINE_FAIL.
Instrumentation/color-byte mismatch is MACHINE_FAIL and invalidates readiness.

required_cpu_negative_and_positive_fixtu.expected: Trajectory-colored analytic geometry under a later UI-owned final sample is rejected as track=none.
A source core covered by the other track with no exposed same-track component remains hidden.
A gate-bounded, final-owned same-track halo, exposed dash-gap solid, nearest tick or same endpoint may rescue exactly one source probe.
A semantic owner whose paired final LDR color does not correspond or lacks >=4.0 edge contrast is rejected.
Two probe claims yield one deterministic winner and one pixel_already_assigned loser; double assignment remains zero.
Evidence inside Euclidean radius but outside either true tangent or normal bound is rejected.
A palette-matching sample owned by the other track is rejected.
A palette-matching track=none scene/background sample is rejected.
Sub-1.5 resolved pixel-equivalent coverage cannot satisfy a probe.
Qualifying resolved coverage is credited exactly once with its measured pixel-equivalent area.
A pre-clip semantic hit absent after production clip/stencil/discard remains hidden.
Missing telemetry or failed durable flush terminates with a telemetry-preservation error before any PASS claim.

required_assertions: No Cocoa, OpenGL or GPU symbol is loaded or invoked.
The original replay and PPM SHA values remain unchanged.
A failure result row is serialized and flushed before the expected fail-closed decision.
Every source ID, per-track/component count, hidden record, candidate and arbitration record is present.
Until integrated Step B evidence is available, analytic ownership is labeled non-final and no 46/49 redistribution is claimed.

required_exit_sequence_before_any_fresh_.required: Bind every modified implementation/test/tooling source and prove production color/route/asset inputs unchanged.
Prove Step B is integrated with production pass ordering and that instrumentation cannot mutate color output, route, offsets, assets, UI layout or thresholds.
Create a new empty output root, fresh plan/source bindings/runner/readiness with all 11 cases NOT_RUN and all evidence claims false.

authorization_must_bind: fresh runner and Billiards binary SHA values
fresh empty targeted output root and plan SHA
CPU fixture and frozen replay receipts

global_forbidden_actions: Running or resuming the frozen targeted ordinal-1 attempt
Overwriting the frozen PPM, empty results file, authorization or failure receipt
Relaxing coverage, contrast or luma thresholds
Deleting, merging, renumbering or changing the 95 ordinal-1 source probes
Changing predicted or actual route, endpoint, world samples, screen-space offset, z-order, palette, assets or inspector layout
Treating detached semantic replay, analytic CPU geometry or PPM color proximity as final ownership proof
Treating this implementation design gate or a future readiness manifest as GPU authorization
Claiming implementation complete, machine PASS, M3, Beta or golden from this design gate
decision: AUTHORIZE FUTURE A-THEN-B TELEMETRY IMPLEMENTATION ONLY; FIRST PASS CPU FIXTURES AND FROZEN FAILURE REPLAY; THEN PREPARE FRESH TARGETED READINESS WITHOUT RUNNING IT
